title: (Junior) Aerospace Engineer - Space Safety & SSA (m/w/d)
description: Join us in building solutions that keep space safe and sustainable. As part of our team, you’ll work on varied projects and products across Space Flight Dynamics (FD), Space Situational Awareness (SSA), Space Traffic Management (STM), and Space Surveillance & Tracking (SST).

title: Backend Developer (Java & Python, Microservices)
description:
Your mission is to design and maintain a scalable, asynchronous backend that powers OKAPI:Orbits' end-to-end solutions across mission design, Space Situational Awareness (SSA), Space Traffic Management (STM), Flight Dynamics (FD), and Space Traffic Coordination (STC), supporting satellite operators throughout their entire mission lifecycle.

You'll work primarily on external customer projects with a Python-based tech stack, while also contributing in parallel to our products built on Java Spring Boot. You design and implement robust microservices that process and distribute large volumes of orbital and telemetry data to deliver reliable APIs and automation processes. You already bring solid experience and take independent ownership of parts of the backend architecture across both environments.

You'll work on the systems that enable satellite operators and space agencies to analyze, coordinate, and protect their missions in an increasingly crowded space environment.

Studies show that women are less likely to apply for a position if they don't meet 100% of the requirements. Please know that we explicitly encourage you to apply if this applies to you, as long as you bring a passion for space technology, reliable software development, and sustainable use of space.
OKAPI:Orbits already brings together a highly diverse team and is actively committed to growing that diversity further, since studies show that heterogeneous teams achieve better results and drive innovation.

title: IT Admin / System Administrator (m/f/d)
description:
Our infrastructure is the backbone of everything we do at OKAPI:Orbits. As IT Administrator, you are the go-to technical expert for all IT matters in the company. No senior above you, no escalation path upward. You make independent decisions about how our infrastructure runs today and what it should look like tomorrow.

You take full ownership of our IT landscape: from on-premise servers and Docker infrastructure to laptops across all operating systems, Microsoft 365, network security, and long-term hardware and server planning. You'll be supported by a trainee (Auszubildender) who you mentor and develop as part of the role.

title: Sales Development Representative for Space Applications (m/w/d)
description:
As Sales Development Representative at OKAPI:Orbits, your mission is to fuel the growth of space-traffic-coordination and space-safety adoption worldwide. You turn OKAPI:Orbits' vision of a safer, more sustainable space environment into commercial momentum by identifying promising prospects, opening new conversations, and building the foundation of trusted relationships across the global space industry.

Through sharp market research, persistent outreach, and a genuine curiosity for the space sector, you connect with satellite operators, launch providers, insurers, defence and governmental organizations to spark their interest in navigating space more safely and efficiently. Your work ensures that OKAPI:Orbits' cutting-edge technologies reach the right people at the right time, generating the qualified pipeline that powers our growth in the expanding space economy.

title: Sales Manager for Space Applications (m/w/d)
description:
As Sales Manager at OKAPI:Orbits, your mission is to accelerate the adoption of space‑traffic‑management and space‑safety solutions worldwide. You turn OKAPI:Orbits’ vision of a safer, more sustainable space environment into commercial reality by building trusted partnerships, expanding our global customer base, and championing the value of responsible operations in orbit.
Through strategic leadership, deep market insight, and a passion for innovation, you empower satellite operators, launch providers, insurers, defence and governmental organizations to navigate space more safely and efficiently. Your work ensures that OKAPI:Orbits’ cutting‑edge technologies become an essential foundation for the growing space economy, protecting assets, reducing collision risks, and enabling humanity’s continued access to space.

title: Senior Satellite Systems Engineer
description: Join us in safeguarding the sustainability of space operations through advanced space situational awareness (SSA) technologies. As part of our team, you will develop cutting-edge collision avoidance algorithms, enhance space situational awareness, and innovate tools for satellite operators. Your expertise in data science and physics will help us detect, predict, and mitigate orbital risks, ensuring safe and sustainable space exploration.

title: Space Situational Awareness Internship / Master Thesis (m/w/d)
description:
Join us in shaping the future of safe and sustainable space operations. At OKAPI Orbits, we develop innovative technologies and data-driven solutions to protect the space environment and empower decision-makers across the space industry. title: Team Lead Java Development (m/f/d)
description:
Your mission is to lead our Java Development team within the Software Engineering department, both technically and as a disciplinary manager, and to build scalable, reliable, and maintainable software together with your team as part of OKAPI:Orbits' end-to-end solutions. You will support a team of currently five Java developers in designing, implementing, and sustainably operating modern services and event-driven systems.

In this role, you combine genuine technical contribution with strong people leadership. You write and review code alongside your team, create clarity in priorities, actively invest in the growth of your team members, and ensure that technical decisions align with company goals and customer needs. In doing so, you directly contribute to enabling satellite operators and space agencies to efficiently plan, monitor, and control their missions in an increasingly dynamic orbital environment.

title: Technical Project Manager - Space Domain Software (m/w/d)
description:
We are looking for a Technical Project Manager in Space Domain Software who thrives at the intersection of technology, people leadership, and customer success. In this hybrid technical + management role, you will lead a small engineering team, manage key customer projects, and contribute directly to the development of advanced space systems across flight dynamics, SSA/SST, and mission operations.

You’ll act as both a hands-on engineer and a strategic project leader, guiding software development, steering technical discussions with satellite operators, and ensuring customer satisfaction across commercial and institutional missions.

This is a high-impact role with broad ownership. You’ll contribute to technical delivery, customer success, and strategic initiatives, including proposals and projects for space sustainability, SSA/SST, and mission operations.

title: Working Student Full-Stack Development (Angular/Java) (m/f/d)
description:
Your mission is to support the team in developing and maintaining intuitive and high performance web applications and APIs. You will contribute to enabling seamless access to OKAPI:Orbits end to end solutions across Mission Design, Space Situational Awareness (SSA), Space Traffic Management (STM), Flight Dynamics (FD) and Space Traffic Coordination (STC), while gaining insights into the full lifecycle of satellite operations.

title: Working Student Recruiting (m/f/d)
description: As a Working Student in talent acquisition at OKAPI:Orbits, you play an active role in finding the right talent for our team, which builds SaaS solutions covering the entire satellite lifecycle. You support our Operations team in day-to-day operations, help keep the application process running smoothly, and make sure new colleagues get the best possible start with us. This includes maintaining an overview of all open positions, ensuring a smooth handover of candidates between stages and coordinating interview slots with different departments.
